LightningComponentBundle.description: Displays a collection of Answered Questions and allows editing answers based on their data type. Returns a new collection without Ids.

property.name: inputAnsweredQuestions
property.label: Input Answered Questions
property.description: The collection of Answered Question records to display and edit.

property.name: outputAnsweredQuestions
property.label: Output Answered Questions (No Ids)
property.description: The edited collection of Answered Question records without Ids, for creating new records.

property.name: outputAnsweredQuestionsWithIds
property.label: Output Answered Questions (With Ids)
property.description: The edited collection of Answered Question records with Ids, for updating existing records.
